## Comments

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-09-21T10:16:38Z

**The red is not this bump.** I re-ran the failed shard at the same head `d0f17d8f89`, same lockfile, same code — `e2e-engine (1/2)` passed. One green rerun proves the failure is not deterministic at this tree; it does not prove the bump can never perturb that arm, so the narrow claim is what I am asserting.

**What actually failed.** Not an assertion in the spec — the `workerErrors` auto-fixture (`test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:138`) caught a console error at teardown of `colors/tearOutMatrix.spec.mjs:104` (`row 2 probe — activation decay-trace capture across an 8s held gesture`):

```
PortDisconnectedError: Worker port disconnected before reply: neo-port-6
    at App.removePort   (src/worker/Base.mjs:505:37)
    at App.onDisconnect (src/worker/Base.mjs:552:44)
```

115 passed, 1 failed, 3 skipped. A torn-out window closing while an `initVnode` reply is still in flight.

**Why the bump cannot reach it.** `autoprefixer` and `cssnano` are imported in exactly two places, `buildScripts/build/themes.mjs` and `buildScripts/helpers/watchThemes.mjs`, and the e2e-engine job runs neither: its build steps are `npm ci` and `npm run bundle-browser-deps` (parse5, marked, mermaid, monaco, highlight.js). No PostCSS runs in that job, and the tier serves unbundled source from the dev server. `browserslist`, `electron-to-chromium` and `node-releases` moved too, but they are autoprefixer's inputs and reach the same dead end.

**Why the other three PRs stayed green on the same specs.** The e2e selection is not diff-scoped — `RUN_PATHS` in `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` is a fixed list that includes `test/playwright/e2e/colors`, so #19022, #19023 and #19024 all executed this spec and passed within the same window. The tier does produce single-arm intermittents elsewhere: run `35478524656` on `dev` yesterday failed one unrelated grid arm and nothing else.

Two things worth separating out, neither blocking this PR:

- `colors/tearOutMatrix.spec.mjs:104` is now a named intermittent. `e2eCiSelection.mjs` has an `EXCLUSIONS` shape for exactly this, with `kind: 'observed'` for a failure whose cause is not established — which is the honest label here. I am not adding it on one observation; a second sighting should.
- The teardown race itself is in `worker/Base.mjs#removePort`, not in the test. That is engine-side and outgrows this thread.

⚖️ **Ada** · `@neo-opus-ada` · Claude Opus 5 · Claude Code
